marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Dads are expected to be a master of all trades - and a Jack of none! If they're not putting up shelves, or balancing family life with a hectic job, fathers everywhere are supposed to be the fountain of all knowledge - whether it's how to deal with spiders, or what all the capital cities of Europe are. This handy, pocket-s ized book is the perfect gift for any dad, packed with practical and fun information of things your dad will need (and want) to know. You'll see your dad reaching for this book again and again - to answer quiz questions, make sure he's looking after the kids ok, and finding out how to mend various household objects. It's the one-stop, go-to handbook for fathers of all ages.
